        pointer = address(uint160(data >> 40));

    function _getTraitItem(uint8 traitId, uint256 index) internal view returns (uint16) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(traitId);
        uint256 data = _loadStorage(slot);
        uint16 count = uint16(data & 0xFFFF);
        if (index >= count) revert InvalidTraitIndex();
        
        address pointer = address(uint160(data >> 40));
        uint80 baseOffset = uint80(data >> 16 & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF);
        
        // Read from pointer contract
        uint80 itemOffset = baseOffset + uint80(index * 20);
        bytes memory result = _readFromPointer(pointer, itemOffset, 20);
        return uint16(uint256(bytes32(result)) >> 240);
    }

    function _addTraits(uint8 traitId, bytes calldata data, uint80 pointer, uint16 count) internal {

        if (pointer > 0xFFFF) revert InvalidPointer();
        
        // Deploy data as contract

        // Update storage slot
        uint256 slot = uint256(traitId);
        uint256 existing = _loadStorage(slot);
        uint16 existingCount = uint16(existing & 0xFFFF);
        
        uint256 newData = (uint256(uint160(dataPointer)) << 40) |

                          uint256(existingCount + count);

    }

    function _addTraitsFromPointer(uint8 traitId, address srcPointer, uint80 dest, uint16 count) internal {

        if (dest > 0xFFFF) revert InvalidPointer();

        uint16 existingCount = uint16(existing & 0xFFFF);

        uint256 newData = existing | uint256(existingCount + count);
        _storeStorage(slot, newData);
    }

    function _deploy(bytes calldata data) internal returns (address addr) {
        uint256 len = data.length;
        if (len == 0 || len > 0xFFFF) revert InvalidDataLength();
        
        bytes memory code = new bytes(len);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            code[i] = data[i];
        }

            addr := create(0, add(code, 0x20), len)
        }
        
        if (addr == address(0)) revert DeploymentFailed();
    }

    function _readFromPointer(address pointer, uint80 offset, uint256 length) internal view returns (bytes memory) {

        }

        assembly {
            value := sload(slot)
        }
    }

        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
        numberOfLeavingNodes--;
        numberOfLeftNodes++;
        
        address nodeService = getContract("NodeService");
        INodeService(nodeService).handleNodeRemoving(nodeId);
        
        emit ExitCompleted(nodeId, validatorId, block.timestamp);
    }
    
    function setNodeInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node should be Active");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 4;
        numberOfActiveNodes--;
    }
    
    function removeNodeFromInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 4, "Node is not In Maintenance");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 1;
        numberOfActiveNodes++;
    }
    
    function changeNodeFinishTime(uint256 nodeId, uint256 newFinishTime) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1 || _nodes[nodeId].status == 2, "Node is not Active");
        _nodes[nodeId].finishTime = newFinishTime;
    }
    
    function changeNodeLastRewardDate(uint256 nodeId) external {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node is not Active");
        _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate = block.timestamp;
    }
    
    function addSpaceToNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 space) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace + space <= TOTAL_SPACE_ON_NODE, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].freeSpace += space;
        spaceToNodes[_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace].push(nodeId);
    }
    
    function removeSpaceFromNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 space) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace >= space, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].freeSpace -= space;
    }
    
    function deleteNodeForValidator(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeIndex) external onlyMaintainer {
        uint256[] storage nodeIdxs = validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId];
        require(nodeIndex < nodeIdxs.length, "Node does not exist for this Validator");
        
        uint256 nodeId = nodeIdxs[nodeIndex];
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
        
        if (_nodes[nodeId].status == 1) {
            numberOfActiveNodes--;
        }
    }
    
    function countNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256) {
        return spaceToNodes[space].length;
    }
    
    function getNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return spaceToNodes[space];
    }
    
    function isTimeForReward(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return block.timestamp >= _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate + 30 days;
    }
    
    function getNextRewardTimestamp(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate + 30 days;
    }
    
    function getBounty() external view returns (uint256) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getBounty();
    }
    
    function getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(uint256 validatorId) external returns (uint256) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(validatorId);
    }
    
    function populateBountyV2(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        IValidatorService(validatorService).getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(validatorId);
    }
    
    function removeNodeAddress(uint256 nodeId, address nodeAddress) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].owner == nodeAddress, "Node does not exist for this Validator");
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
    }
    
    function handleNodeCreation(uint256 nodeId) external {
        // Called by NodeService
    }
    
    function handleNodeRemoving(uint256 nodeId) external {
        // Called by NodeService
    }
}

    function batch(bytes[] calldata calls, bool revertOnFail) external payable returns (bool[] memory successes, bytes[] memory results) {
        successes = new bool[](calls.length);
        results = new bytes[](calls.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(calls[i]);
            if (revertOnFail && !success) {
                if (result.length < 68) revert();
                assembly {
                    result := add(result, 0x04)

            successes[i] = success;

        return _balances[user];
    }

        require(msg.value >= price, "Ether sent is not correct");
        
        _mint(to, amount, kingdom, 0, tier);
    }

        require(_owners[tokenId] == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount, uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint256 tier) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _totalSupply + START_TOKEN_ID;
            _owners[tokenId] = to;
            _balances[to] += 1;
            _tokenKingdom[tokenId] = kingdom;
            _tokenGender[tokenId] = gender;
            _tokenTier[tokenId] = tier;

            _totalSupply++;

    }

        if (_roles[role][account] == 0) {
            _roles[role][account] = 1;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role][account] != 0) {
            _roles[role][account] = 0;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            else assembly { revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) }
        }
    }

    function recoverSigner(bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(signature.length == 65, "ECDSA: invalid signature length");
        
        bytes32 r;
        bytes32 s;
        uint8 v;
        
        assembly {
            r := mload(add(signature, 32))
            s := mload(add(signature, 64))
            v := byte(0, mload(add(signature, 96)))
        }
        
        if (v < 27) v += 27;
        require(v == 27 || v == 28, "ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");
        
        return ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
    }

    function uint256ToString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

}
